episode.logline: Inside the opulent Ashbury estate, the treacherous Rupert and Catherine plot to seize the ducal title as the Dowager Duchess slowly withers, while in an icy barn, Juliana defiantly prepares remedies to save the fever-stricken villagers.
episode.continuity_notes: Follows Episode 19's night in the barn; as Alexander begins his clandestine fight to reclaim his birthright, Juliana tends to the suffering village while Rupert and Catherine celebrate their anticipated ascension to the ducal throne.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle establishing shot tilting up toward the imposing, grand stone facade of Ashbury Manor against a cold, overcast morning sky, frost dusting the pristine lawn.
events.scene_heading: EXT. ASHBURY MANOR – DAY

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium wide shot of the lavish drawing room. CATHERINE, dressed in an ornate lilac regency gown and white satin gloves, gracefully pours hot tea from an ornate silver teapot, while RUPERT stands elegantly by the tall window.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Smug, Prim):
events.text: "Two lumps of sugar, Rupert?"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Taunting, Silkily):
events.text: "Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine stirring her tea with a silver spoon, lifting her gaze with a haughty smirk.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: RUPERT (Flirtatious, Sly):
events.text: "Only if it sweetens your disposition, Catherine."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot tracking Rupert as he steps forward from the hearth, adjusting his dark leather gloves with an air of absolute triumph.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: RUPERT (Boastful, Confident):
events.text: "The estate is practically ours."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: RUPERT (Smug):
events.text: "The succession papers are being finalized as we speak."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Catherine raising the porcelain teacup to her lips, her expression turning sharp and dismissive.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Cold, Haughty):
events.text: "'Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Stern, Ambitious):
events.text: "I marry the Lord of Ashbury."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Rupert striding toward the tea table, leaning forward with predatory conviction.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: RUPERT (Reassuring, Firm):
events.text: "And so you shall."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: RUPERT (Dark, Conspiratorial):
events.text: "Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown..."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: RUPERT (Decisive):
events.text: "...the title is mine."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Wary, Inquiring):
events.text: "And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine lowering her teacup, her icy blue eyes narrowing in calculated concern.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Disdainful):
events.text: "Her shadow still hangs over this house."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: RUPERT (Quiet, Sinister):
events.text: "Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tight close-up of Rupert's face as a sinister grin spreads across his features.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: RUPERT (Gloating):
events.text: "They call it a wasting of the lungs."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up side profile of Catherine bringing the teacup to her lips, savoring his words with chilling detachment.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Mock-Sympathetic, Cruel):
events.text: "How tragic. The slow, quiet decline."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Scheming):
events.text: "How much longer can the frail thing survive?"
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium profile of Rupert looking out the window, hands clasped behind him.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: RUPERT (Cold, Callous):
events.text: "Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine turning her head toward the window, her lips curled in venomous disgust.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Vindictive):
events.text: "Good. The village is already whispering about her."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Contemptuous):
events.text: "The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Disgusted):
events.text: "They disgust me."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium two-shot. Rupert stands over Catherine seated at the polished table, placing a gloved hand possessively near her shoulder.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: RUPERT (Dismissive, Arrogant):
events.text: "They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: RUPERT (Authoritative, Promising):
events.text: "They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up tilting down on JULIANA kneeling in the straw beside a rustic wooden crate, sorting sprigs of dried lavender and sage into a woven basket. Her hands are bound in linen bandages from the recent fire.
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: The barn door opens, revealing daylight outside. SEAMUS, an older weathered villager in a waistcoat, carries a wooden bucket inside, his expression etched with deep sorrow and concern.
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: SEAMUS (Gentle, Concerned):
events.text: "Let me take that basket, Lady Juliana."
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: SEAMUS (Empathetic):
events.text: "Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft."
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Seamus reaches down to take the handle of the basket from her.
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Resolute):
events.text: "If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins."
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up at Seamus, her smudged face fierce with unyielding determination as she holds firmly onto the basket.
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: JULIANA (Defiant):
events.text: "I do not yield to a cold draft."
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Seamus, his face agonizingly strained with grief for her lost status.
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: SEAMUS (Desperate, Grieving):
events.text: "You are a viscount's daughter!"
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: SEAMUS (Pleading):
events.text: "Sleeping on straw, sorting weeds!"
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: SEAMUS (Frustrated):
events.text: "Let the village tend to itself for once!"
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unwavering moral strength.
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Unflinching):
events.text: "The chapel is gone, Seamus. I am the only healer these people have left."
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: JULIANA (Unyielding):
events.text: "I keep the basket."
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium two-shot of Juliana and Seamus standing facing each other in the barn, the lantern casting a warm amber glow between them.
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: SEAMUS (Saddened, Heartbroken):
events.text: "They have reduced you to a peasant."
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: JULIANA (Proud, Indomitable):
events.text: "They have reduced me to myself."
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: JULIANA (Steely):
events.text: "And I am not finished."
events.scene_heading: INT. ABANDONED BARN – DAY

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Catherine's gloved hand sets her fine porcelain teacup down onto the silver tray with a delicate clatter.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: Sharp porcelain chime of teacup meeting saucer.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine looking up, her face twisting into venomous arrogance.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Callous):
events.text: "Let the peasants rot in their barns."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Spiteful):
events.text: "Let them pray to their weeds."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot as Rupert steps around the mahogany table and leans close into Catherine's ear, smiling seductively.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: RUPERT (Intimate, Reassuring):
events.text: "You have no rival here, Catherine."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: RUPERT (Fawning):
events.text: "No one to stand in your way."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Catherine looking into Rupert's eyes, her smile turning predatory and cold.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Triumphant, Greedy):
events.text: "Once the old Duchess is gone..."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Possessive):
events.text: "...Ashbury will finally belong to us."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Catherine rises from her chair in one regal motion and glides toward the towering window overlooking the vast estate grounds.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tracking medium shot following Catherine from behind as she walks gracefully to the window frame, the grey morning light outlining her aristocratic silhouette.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CATHERINE (Cold, Ruthless):
events.text: "This house will only bow to me."
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tight close-up profile of Catherine gazing out the windowpane, her icy eyes burning with insatiable ambition as dramatic strings swell to a menacing cliffhanger hold.
events.scene_heading: INT. ASHBURY MANOR - DRAWING ROOM – CONTINUOUS
